name: ai-framework
description: AI-First Software Engineering Framework: Lifecycle Skills, Standalone Utilities, MCPs, and Test Suites

plugins.name: ai-first-fw-skills
plugins.description: Core AI-First Framework lifecycle skills: analysis-handoff, implementation-planner, specs-builder, specs-reviewer, plan-reviewer, and code-reviewer.

plugins.name: ai-first-fw-utilities
plugins.description: Standalone engineering utility skills: lv1-diagram-maker, lv1-architecture-review, lv1-doc-writer, lv1-prompt-builder, pr-desc-writer, unslop, glossary-maker, naver-api-extractor, and lotteon-api-extractor.

plugins.name: ai-first-fw-mcps
plugins.description: Local stdio MCP servers: jira-reader (issue metadata, ADF descriptions, attachment downloads) and kibana-explorer (enterprise log search via KQL). Install this where project-scoped .mcp.json is not read, such as Cowork.
